tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels: the task list, milestone rail cards, dialogs.

tokens.name: river
tokens.usage: White River from the palette. Sidebar, secondary button fill, sunken wells, today's cell in the calendar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between task rows, card and input borders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and river (11.7:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata (project · milestone), captions; on bg, surface and river (4.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: jojoba
tokens.usage: Jojoba, the brand hue. Brand marks, active nav icon, progress, project dots. Never as a text color on light grounds at body size.

tokens.name: jojoba-strong
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Jojoba deepened one step so on-jojoba text passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: jojoba-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed.

tokens.name: on-jojoba
tokens.usage: Text and icons on jojoba-strong and jojoba-hover.

tokens.name: jojoba-soft
tokens.usage: Active nav item ground, 'zrobione' chip ground, selected filter chip.

tokens.name: jojoba-ink
tokens.usage: Text on jojoba-soft.

tokens.name: kensington
tokens.usage: Kensington Green. Selected day in the calendar, info accents, project dot.

tokens.name: kensington-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for 'jutro' chips and info banners.

tokens.name: kensington-ink
tokens.usage: Text on kensington-soft and on surface; also the focus ring color.

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: English Ochre. 'Due today' signal (dot, bar), project dot.

tokens.name: ochre-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for the 'dziś' chip and milestone-soon warnings.

tokens.name: ochre-ink
tokens.usage: Text on ochre-soft and on surface.

tokens.name: brick
tokens.usage: Boston Brick. Overdue and destructive actions (fill).

tokens.name: on-brick
tokens.usage: Text on a brick fill (destructive button).

tokens.name: brick-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for the 'po terminie' chip and overdue banners.

tokens.name: brick-ink
tokens.usage: Text on brick-soft and on surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset; 6.4:1 on bg (light), 10.6:1 (dark).

tokens.name: project-sage
tokens.usage: Project color 1 (dot, calendar bar).

tokens.name: project-kensington
tokens.usage: Project color 2.

tokens.name: project-ochre
tokens.usage: Project color 3.

tokens.name: project-brick
tokens.usage: Project color 4.

tokens.name: project-teal
tokens.usage: Project color 5, a deepened Kensington.

tokens.name: project-sand
tokens.usage: Project color 6, a lightened Ochre. Dots carry a 1px line ring so light hues still read.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Date heading on the day view; project name on the project view. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Month title in the calendar, dialog titles.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section headings inside a screen (rail, milestone groups).

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Milestone descriptions and empty-state lines. Sparingly.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Zadania ze wszystkich projektów, posortowane wg terminu.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Project · milestone line under a task, in ink-muted.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels over groups (nav sections, filters). Always letter-spaced.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Task row vertical padding; gap between dot, check and text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; minimum side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between rail cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections; main column padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top padding above the display heading on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, calendar day cells, inputs' inner elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, dialogs (echoes the palette card corners).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large sheets on mobile (bottom sheet, add-task panel).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, filter chips, nav items. The pill is the system's signature shape.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Surface panels on bg. Kept faint; borders do most separation.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the mobile add button.
